newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse suspends First Asia.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse suspends First Asia.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) on Monday suspended shares of First Asia Securities Plc after halting trade on the company's shares earlier in the day.
The SET had said in a statement then that it was awaiting further details from the company regarding its recent merger with Securities One Plc.

The switch from halt to the suspension of trading of First Asia came after the company told the SET later on Monday that it had agreed to sell 90 million baht ($3.46 million) of fixed assets to Securities One.
The assets sale, to be completed by end-February, was part of Securities One's takeover of First Asia that began last year.
The SET said it was now awaiting more information from the company.
